name: Halfling
description: Small, steady and much harder to rattle than they look. Halflings reroll their worst luck, slip through spaces larger folk cannot, and are almost impossible to frighten.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.description: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, an ability check or a saving throw, reroll the die and use the new roll.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature of a size larger than yours.
